Cara bermainHow to play

  • Betul: +10 (bonus jika betul berturut-turut). Salah: −5.Correct: +10 (bonus for streaks). Wrong: −5.
  • Masa 60 saat. Boleh guna kekunci 1–5.You have 60 seconds. Keys 1–5 also work.
  • Kompos hanya untuk kulit buah, sisa sayur dan daun kering. Daging, tulang dan sisa makanan basah masuk Sisa Am.Compost is only for fruit peels, raw vegetable scraps and dry leaves. Meat, bones and wet food waste go to General Waste.
